item.title: Huang Floats Nvidia Comeback, Ilhan Omar Investigation Update, Surfer Murder Twist: AM Update 11/18 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang expresses interest in returning to the company he co-founded as federal investigations expand, and Congress prepares to question him. A federal judge orders the release of previously sealed court records related to the criminal investigation involving Democrat Congresswoman Ilhan Omar. The girlfriend of murdered California surfing legend Kurt Van Dyke is arrested on suspicion of helping orchestrate his killing in Costa Rica. New research identifies biological differences in pancreatic cancer tumors that could help scientists develop more personalized treatments.
